capabilities: Geocode the address property of the current note
Write coordinates into the location property
Record a match_level for the result
Leave the note unchanged and explain when no sure answer is found
Set the address of the GridPin server in settings
extras: Desktop only; on a phone 127.0.0.1 is the phone itself. Server data files exist for Australia, Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Mexico, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Poland, Serbia, Spain and the United States. Text and code were prepared with an AI assistant; licence Apache-2.0.
problem: Map views read coordinates from the location property, but notes usually hold only a written address.

relations.evidence: writes the coordinates into location, the property that map views such as Map View read
The answer comes from your own GridPin server on your computer or network.

summary: Reads a note's address property, asks a local GridPin server for coordinates, and writes them into the location property.
